cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. This holiday photo would make a lovely anniversary card. Look at that sunset.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who's holding your hand at the edge?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Would you prefer the beach photo? More room for a message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same person, same bracelet. Who is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That bracelet's exactly your colour. Shall I find you one for our anniversary?

mechanism: A uses confident photo-editing correction to redirect each identity question into composition and print decisions.
confusable: General complimenting or gifting would be unrelated; S03's editing expertise must use B's actual inspection of the photo.
comparison: A visual-evidence evasion differs from dinner scheduling around a key.
seedUse: Use anniversary photo, hand and bracelet; turn B's zoom into a concrete editing correction.
